intro: The Whole Pita from CAVA is a soft, sprouted wheat pita bread that serves as a versatile side option for any meal. At 320 calories and packed with 13g of protein, this freshly baked pita complements bowls, wraps, and dips perfectly. Available on the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides), it offers a wholesome bread option made from quality sprouted wheat for enhanced nutrition and flavor.
priceCalories: The Whole Pita is priced between $2.25 and $2.55 depending on location. With 320 calories, 13g of protein, 54g of carbs, and 6g of fat, it provides substantial energy and nutrition. This makes it an excellent addition to lighter meals or as a satisfying side to share. Check the [full CAVA menu](/) for current pricing at your nearest location.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets the Whole Pita apart is its sprouted wheat preparation, which enhances digestibility and nutrient availability. Unlike regular pita bread, sprouted grains offer increased vitamin content and better mineral absorption. The soft, pillowy texture makes it perfect for scooping dips or tearing and sharing. It is a more substantial alternative to the complimentary quarter pita included with bowls.
nutritionFacts: Each Whole Pita contains 320 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile: 13g protein, 54g carbohydrates, and 6g fat. The sprouted wheat base provides complex carbohydrates for sustained energy throughout your day. With 13 grams of protein, it offers more nutritional value than standard pita options. Visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your complete meal macros.
whatsInside: The Whole Pita features a single, quality ingredient: soft sprouted wheat pita bread. Sprouted wheat undergoes a germination process that breaks down starches and increases nutrient bioavailability. This creates a tender, flavorful bread without artificial additives or preservatives. The simple ingredient list makes it suitable for those seeking cleaner eating options from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides).
tasteLike: The Whole Pita offers a subtly sweet, nutty flavor characteristic of sprouted grains. Its soft, pillowy texture is tender yet sturdy enough to hold dips and spreads without tearing. The slightly earthy taste complements Mediterranean flavors beautifully, enhancing rather than overpowering other ingredients. It is warm, comforting, and versatile enough to pair with both savory and mild dishes.
customize: While the Whole Pita comes as-is, you can customize how you enjoy it with various [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) options. Pair it with hummus, tzatziki, or harissa for added flavor dimension. Tear it into pieces for dipping or keep it whole to wrap around your favorite proteins. Consider adding it alongside items from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) for a complete meal.
pairsWell: The Whole Pita pairs exceptionally well with all CAVA dips including hummus, tzatziki, and crazy feta. It complements protein-rich mains like grilled chicken, falafel, or braised lamb perfectly. Use it to scoop up leftover dressings and toppings from your bowl for zero waste. It also works wonderfully alongside options from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) for a heartier meal.
healthyChoice: The Whole Pita offers a healthier bread option thanks to its sprouted wheat composition. Sprouting increases vitamin content, improves digestibility, and reduces antinutrient levels compared to regular wheat. With 13g of protein and complex carbohydrates, it provides sustained energy without blood sugar spikes. For those monitoring specific dietary needs, review the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for detailed ingredient information.
howToOrder: To order the Whole Pita, simply add it to your meal when customizing your bowl or pita at any CAVA location. It appears in the sides section during online ordering or can be requested at the counter. Specify if you want it warmed, which enhances its soft texture and aroma. Find your nearest restaurant through [CAVA Locations](/locations) to enjoy this delicious side today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the complimentary Side Quarter Pita (80 calories), the Whole Pita provides four times the portion at 320 calories. Unlike Classic Pita Chips (280 calories, $2.55-$2.95), it offers a soft texture ideal for wrapping and dipping rather than crunching. The Whole Pita contains more protein (13g) than flavored chip options and provides greater versatility for customization throughout your meal.
whoShouldTry: The Whole Pita is perfect for anyone seeking a substantial bread side to complement their Mediterranean meal. It suits diners who prefer soft bread over crunchy chips for dipping. Those following plant-forward diets will appreciate the sprouted wheat nutrition profile. If you enjoy options from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas), this side lets you recreate that experience with your custom bowl.
worthTrying: The Whole Pita is absolutely worth trying for its superior texture, nutrition, and versatility. At $2.25-$2.55, it offers excellent value for a high-quality sprouted wheat bread. The generous portion satisfies bread cravings while providing meaningful protein and complex carbs. Whether you are dipping, wrapping, or simply enjoying it alongside your meal, it elevates the entire CAVA dining experience deliciously.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a CAVA Whole Pita?
faqs.a: The CAVA Whole Pita contains 320 calories with 13g protein, 54g carbohydrates, and 6g fat. This makes it a substantial side option that provides balanced nutrition and sustained energy for your meal.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Whole Pita at CAVA?
faqs.a: The Whole Pita is priced between $2.25 and $2.55 depending on your location. Pricing may vary slightly by region, so check your local CAVA restaurant for exact pricing information.

faqs.q: Is the CAVA Whole Pita gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the Whole Pita is made from sprouted wheat and contains gluten. For gluten-free options, visit the CAVA Gluten Free Menu to explore suitable alternatives that meet your dietary requirements.

faqs.q: What makes sprouted wheat pita healthier?
faqs.a: Sprouted wheat undergoes germination that increases vitamin content, improves digestibility, and enhances mineral absorption. This process reduces antinutrients and creates a more nutritious bread with better bioavailability of nutrients compared to regular wheat.

faqs.q: Can I get the Whole Pita warmed at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, you can request to have your Whole Pita warmed when ordering. Warming enhances the soft, pillowy texture and brings out the natural nutty flavors of the sprouted wheat for an even more enjoyable experience.
